Title: Waste water
Description: Infrastructure used for the collection and transport of sewage or used water to treatment facilities.

Title: Drinking water
Description: Networks dedicated to the distribution of potable water for human consumption.

Title: Storm water
Description: Systems designed to manage and redirect excess rain and ground water from impervious surfaces.

Title: Gas
Description: Pipelines used for the transport and distribution of natural or manufactured gas.

Title: Oil
Description: Pipelines used for the transport of crude oil or refined petroleum products.

Title: Electricity
Description: High, medium, or low voltage power transmission and distribution lines.

Title: Road
Description: Public or private vehicular thoroughfares, including bridges, tunnels, and associated ducts.

Title: Rail
Description: Infrastructure related to railway tracks, including corridors, signaling conduits, and embankments.
